title: A Speculative Parallel DFA Membership Test for Multicore, SIMD and Cloud Computing Environments
relevance: Foundational work on speculative parallel DFA matching. Demonstrates failure-free speculation with convergence factor gamma < 0.47. Directly applicable to parallelizing JSON string-state tracking across chunks.

title: Parsing gigabytes of JSON per second
relevance: The simdjson paper that established SIMD-based structural indexing as the state of the art. The two-stage architecture (structural indexing then parsing) is the baseline this concept aims to parallelize.

title: Scalable Structural Index Construction for JSON Analytics (Pison)
relevance: Introduced intra-record parallelism for structural index construction. Achieved 9.8x speedup over simdjson's sequential indexing for bulky records. Validates that parallel structural indexing is practical.

title: GpJSON: High-performance JSON Data Processing on GPUs
relevance: Demonstrates parallel structural index construction on GPUs, achieving 2.9x speedup over CPU-based parsers. Shows that massive parallelism in structural indexing is viable on different architectures.

title: Speculative Data-Oblivious Execution: Mobilizing Safe Prediction For Safe and Efficient Speculative Execution
relevance: Shows how to predict the form of data-oblivious execution to get speedups from speculation. Conceptually related to predicting parse states for speculative indexing.
